intent: Connect ground appearance and layered vegetation through versioned habitat data while preserving authored open areas and traversal exclusions.
required_inputs: source-admitted low, medium and accent cover roles appropriate to the concept
licensed or project-authored substrate material inputs
authoritative route, water, hardscape and gameplay exclusions
frozen comparison cameras and scene lighting

shared_field_contract.consumer_mapping: Record each mapping separately; identical output masks are not required.
shared_field_contract.parity: Compare actual consumer samples at shared positions and a predeclared tolerance. Matching equations alone do not establish parity.
shared_field_contract.stale_input_policy: Do not regenerate or promote dependent outputs from an unknown or stale field revision.

output_contract.decorative_collision: NoCollision during visual development; essential traversal remains separately validated
output_contract.source_changes: Recheck final footprint and relevant shape/surface/scene evidence
output_contract.ground_color: Keep layer-specific correction scoped to that layer before blending where the material model requires it
output_contract.library_reuse: Duplicate versioned sources, replace map inputs, and revalidate the new scope

hard_failures: unintended uniform scatter or tiled colony repetition
source silhouette or reverse surface incompatible with its role
unintended fluorescent cover or dark backface bands
unintended green tint on bare substrate
invalid final mesh clearance or filled traversal void
unknown field revision or unverified cross-path parity claimed as passed
promotion_evidence: source shape and surface checks at intended scale and directions
bounded in-context canary and saved source readback
sample parity when separate field implementations are used
dense, sparse, contact, ordinary repetition and reverse scene views
applicable independent visual decision under the project rubric
separate target-platform, wind, performance and packaging checks when required
